    Gary Woodland won the 2026
    Texas Children's Houston Open, earning $1,782,000 from a total purse of $9.9 million. Nicolai Hojgaard took second place, earning $1,079,100, while Johnny Keefer and Min Woo Lee tied for third, each receiving $584,100. 
    2026 Texas Children’s Houston Open Payouts (Top 10) 
    • 1st: Gary Woodland - $1,782,000
    • 2nd: Nicolai Hojgaard - $1,079,100
    • T3: Johnny Keefer - $584,100
    • T3: Min Woo Lee - $584,100
    • 5th: Sam Stevens - $405,900
    • T6: Jake Knapp - $322,987
    • T6: (Multiple Players) - $322,987
    • T8: (Multiple Players) - $272,250
    • T10: Bronson Burgoon - $259,875
    • T10: (Multiple Players) - $259,875 
    Key Details 
    • Total Purse: $9.9 million
    • Winner's Prize: $1,782,000
    • Winner's Points: 500 FedExCup points
    • Tournament Location: Memorial Park Golf Course, Houston, Texas 
    The full payout structure includes earnings for all players who made the cut, with 75th place (Luke Clanton) earning $19,305.
